subject: Re: QuantaPulse hosted API commit increase — coordination & soft transition
messages:
From: Oliver Greene <oliver@quantapulse.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@quantapulse.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commit increase request — QuantaPulse

Hi Naomi,

Quick note following our QBR last week — usage has ramped faster than our forecasts and we hit sustained throughput needs for the next 12 months. We'd like to increase our monthly hosted commit from 1.2M tokens to 2.0M tokens, move up one rate tier, and add a soft burst window for weekends.

We'd also like the term to stay aligned with our fiscal year (ending 2028-06) and discuss a 12-month price ladder that steps with volume. Can you share the proposed commercial terms, any commit migration schedule you recommend, and whether we can lock in current pricing for the first 3 months of the uplift?

I've attached the updated SOW draft (v3) with the requested capacity matrix. Contracts is looped for talk-through.

Thanks,
Oliver
Director of Product
QuantaPulse

Attachment: QP_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Greene <oliver@quantapulse.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, contracts@quantapulse.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase request — QuantaPulse

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and the SOW. Congrats on the ramp — great to see the signals.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I can provision a temporary burst buffer for two weekends during the migration while we finalize the commit change. That should smooth the immediate traffic spikes.
- We will propose a stepped commit ladder (2.0M immediate, with an optional 2.5M after month 6) and a matching rate tier schedule.
- We can honor current unit pricing for the first 60 days of the uplift (we typically do 30–90 day grace periods for renewals).

Ben, can you pull the rate-card scenarios (monthly commit vs unit price) and put two pricing options (standard upgrade and accelerated ladder) into the spreadsheet? Stephanie — can you confirm operational checklist for a soft transition (metrics to watch, KV cache warm-up, recommended autoscale policy) and whether we need any service window?

Oliver — once Contracts confirms redlines on the SOW, we'll send you a redlined commercial proposal and a DocuSign SOW link.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_rate_card_may2027.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Oliver Greene <oliver@quantapulse.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase request — pricing scenarios

Naomi / Stephanie / Oliver — attaching two scenarios:

1) Standard Upgrade: immediate bump to 2.0M tokens/month, unit price moves to Tier 3. Annualized commitment pricing assumes 12-month term. No change to burst policy beyond standard 2x weekend cushion.
2) Accelerated Ladder: 2.0M initial, 2.5M after month 6 with a 6-month partial refund protection if usage dips, unit price averaged across months. This includes a one-time onboarding credit applied to the first invoice.

Operational impact notes: KV cache warm-up recommended 48–72 hours prior to cutover for steady-state traffic; enable autoscale buffer +20% headroom for three weeks. No hard service window required — we can execute rolling config changes across clusters.

Looking forward to your preference — I put detailed math in the attached sheet.

Ben
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_rate_card_may2027.xlsx (updated sheet: scenarios tab)

From: Oliver Greene <oliver@quantapulse.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@quantapulse.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase request — QuantaPulse

Naomi / Ben / Stephanie — thanks for the fast turnaround and the pricing scenarios. QuantaPulse is comfortable moving with the Accelerated Ladder option. A few items from our side:

- Please include the 60-day pricing hold in the commercial proposal and reflect the onboarding credit against the first invoice.
- We request a weekend soft-burst allowance (2.5x) for the first four weekends post-cutover to avoid throttling while our caches warm.
- Contracts will sign the redlined SOW once the DocuSign link matches the spreadsheet (I'll ping contracts to confirm).

If you can send the commercial proposal and DocuSign link by Monday EOD PST, we'll aim to execute and plan a cutover window next week.

Appreciate the help — excited to scale with Redwood.

Best,
Oliver
Director of Product
QuantaPulse
